Thanks for the time today, Priya — quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can align the POC timeline. High-level notes: 
- Objective: Validate Redwood can serve EdgeFin’s realtime document ingestion + semantic search at sub-200ms median token latency for 1–2 request/s sustained per host.
- Constraints: bank-grade SSO + VPC-only traffic, 6-week trial window, dataset is ~120k docs (PII stripped).

Suggested POC outline (short):
1) Kickoff (Week 0): confirm network/IT contacts, provide sample dataset, agree on acceptance metrics.
2) Integration (Week 1–2): connector + ingestion, baseline runs.
3) Acceptance runs (Week 3–4): run evals on agreed prompt set and latency/load.
4) Readout + next steps (Week 5–6): final report, handoff plan, procurement checklist.

Action items for EdgeFin: 
- Priya: confirm SSO owner and security contact (name + email) by EOD Thu.
- Procurement: confirm standard PO timeline and any required vendor forms.

Action items for Redwood: 
- Jordan: deliver success-metrics spreadsheet and mutual action plan (attached).
- Marissa: scope rough infra needs and point engineer.

Attachments: EdgeFin_POC-success-metrics.xlsx (success metrics + eval prompts).

Would love to lock a kickoff for the week of Apr 10 if that works. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Jordan

Priya — thanks. Attached is a slightly expanded mutual action plan and a success-metrics workbook (EdgeFin_POC-success-metrics.xlsx). Key items pulled out here so they're easy to scan: 

Success criteria (pass/fail style):
- Latency: median per-token generation path under 200ms for typical 512-token sessions during 95th percentile of steady-state traffic (1–2 rps).
- Quality: end-to-end relevancy (MRR@10) increase >= 22% vs current baseline on the provided eval set.
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate on inference requests across test window.
- Security: SSO SAML integration completed, and audit logs flowing to EdgeFin's SIEM (sample event set validated).

Proposed milestone dates (US/Eastern friendly):
- Apr 11, 2028 — Kickoff (60m) — confirm contacts, security checklist, ingestion plan.
- Apr 12–19 — Connector build & ingestion (Marissa owner).
- Apr 20–26 — Baseline evaluation + tuning (Ben owner).
- Apr 27–May 3 — Acceptance runs + gap fixes.
- May 8 — Final readout + recommendations.

Ownership:
- Redwood technical lead: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com).
- Redwood performance lead: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.com).
- EdgeFin technical contact: Sameer Patel (sameer.patel@edgefin.com) once looped.

Pre-kickoff checklist (what we'll ask you to confirm):
- Network egress allowlist (IP ranges + port list)
- Test dataset sample (500 docs) uploaded to shared folder
- SSO metadata file or IdP admin contact

I've also included a short mutual action plan PDF for procurement (Redwood_Mutual-Action-Plan.pdf). If those milestone dates look OK I'll send calendar invites and a short runbook for the kickoff.

Jordan
